image_placeholders.description: Silhouette of a single person at a desk with multiple computer screens, surrounded by darkness, with small dots of light visible in the far distance representing other isolated researchers
image_placeholders.purpose: Visually convey the isolation of talented researchers who are disconnected from each other

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Background image with dark overlay. Center-aligned title in large white text: '世界レベルの才能、しかし孤立' (World-class talent, yet isolated). No bullet points. The image tells the story of isolation.
visual_designs.justification: Opening slide needs emotional impact. A powerful image of isolation combined with a short, provocative statement creates immediate intrigue. Bullet points would kill the dramatic effect.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Use Slidev's `layout: fact` with the number '¥1,400億' displayed prominently in red (#ef4444) to signify the negative impact. Below it, a single line in gray (#9ca3af): '削減された運営費交付金 (2004年以降)'. Optional secondary line showing rank drops: '論文ランキング: 2位→4位'
visual_designs.justification: The ¥1,400 billion figure is the most powerful piece of evidence. Displaying it as a single dominant number creates immediate shock value. The ranking decline serves as supporting context but remains secondary.

image_placeholders.description: Scenic view of Toyama's mountainous landscape with a single small building or house, emphasizing geographical isolation and solitude
image_placeholders.purpose: Ground the anecdote in a real place and visually represent the engineer's 5-year isolated journey

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Background image of Toyama landscape with dark overlay (60% opacity). Center text: '富山、5年間、一人' (Toyama, 5 years, alone). Subtitle in smaller gray text: 'Haskell製EVMコンパイラを作り続けるエンジニア'. The stark simplicity emphasizes the loneliness of the story.
visual_designs.justification: This is an anecdote slide—it MUST have a visual. The Jobs approach: let the image and minimal text tell the emotional story. The speaker notes carry the detailed narrative while the slide creates atmosphere.

visual_designs.diagram_code:
```mermaid
graph LR
    A[日本の現状] -->|予算削減| B[孤立した研究者]
    C[イーサリアム] -->|潤沢な助成金| D[グローバル協働]
    
    style A fill:#ef4444,color:#fff
    style B fill:#ef4444,color:#fff
    style C fill:#22c55e,color:#fff
    style D fill:#22c55e,color:#fff
```

image_placeholders.description: Official Ethereum diamond logo in purple/violet color
image_placeholders.purpose: Establish Ethereum as a credible, recognizable entity and create visual association

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Left column: The Mermaid diagram showing contrast (4 nodes). Right column: Ethereum logo with text '数兆円規模の機会' and '日本からの参入者：極めて少ない' in green (#22c55e) to indicate opportunity.
visual_designs.justification: This slide pivots from problem to opportunity. A simple 4-node diagram with red (problem) and green (opportunity) color coding instantly communicates the contrast. The Ethereum logo adds credibility.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Title: 'イーサリアムが求める専門性'. Three key research areas revealed with `<v-clicks>`: 1) '形式検証' (Formal Verification) with icon, 2) '暗号プリミティブ' (Cryptographic Primitives) with icon, 3) 'セキュリティ監査' (Security Audit) with icon. Each item styled as a large card/badge in purple (#8b5cf6). Footer text: 'PSE RFPリストで公開中' with link indicator.
visual_designs.justification: This slide maps audience skills to opportunities. Using v-clicks with 3 large styled cards (not bullet points) creates engagement and allows the speaker to elaborate on each area. The purple color signals these as branded/important items.

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Nyx Foundation logo at top. Dominant number: '20+' in large green (#22c55e) text. Subtitle: '発見・報告した脆弱性' (Vulnerabilities discovered and reported). Below, a simple horizontal list of credibility markers: 'イーサリアム財団 | ZK Tokyo | 共同研究' in gray text.
visual_designs.justification: Credibility slides need proof, not promises. The '20+' number is concrete evidence. Supporting credibility markers are listed minimally below. The logo establishes the organization visually.

visual_designs.diagram_code:
```mermaid
graph TD
    A[あなたの研究] --> B[Nyx Foundation]
    B --> C[助成金情報]
    B --> D[研究相談]
    B --> E[仲間とのつながり]
    
    style A fill:#8b5cf6,color:#fff
    style B fill:#f59e0b,color:#fff
    style C fill:#22c55e,color:#fff
    style D fill:#22c55e,color:#fff
    style E fill:#22c55e,color:#fff
```
visual_designs.content_arrangement: Centered Mermaid diagram showing Nyx Foundation as the hub connecting researchers to three outputs. Title above diagram: '私たちができること'. The diagram uses 5 nodes exactly: Your Research → Nyx Foundation → (Grant Info, Research Consultation, Community). Orange for Nyx, green for benefits, purple for the researcher.
visual_designs.justification: This slide explains Nyx's value proposition. A hub-and-spoke diagram (5 nodes) is clearer than bullet points and visually shows how Nyx Foundation serves as the connector. Color coding differentiates the researcher (you), the organization, and the benefits.

image_placeholders.description: Abstract visualization of interconnected nodes forming a network, with bright connection lines against a dark background, symbolizing global collaboration
image_placeholders.purpose: Visually represent the paradigm shift from isolation to networked collaboration

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Use `layout: statement` with the core message: '孤独な天才の時代は終わった' (The era of the lone genius is over). Background image shows collaboration network. Single line below in gray: '協働する仲間が、世界レベルの成果を生む'.
visual_designs.justification: This is the philosophical climax of the presentation. A powerful statement layout with minimal text and evocative background image delivers the paradigm-shift message with maximum impact. No diagrams or bullets needed.

image_placeholders.description: QR code linking to Nyx Foundation Discord server, with clear scan instructions
image_placeholders.purpose: Enable immediate action—audience can join the community right now by scanning
Brand reinforcement on the final CTA slide

visual_designs.content_arrangement: Dark background with Nyx Foundation logo at top. Center: Large QR code for Discord. Above QR: '今日、つながろう' (Connect today) in large white text. Below QR: 'Discord コミュニティに参加' in orange (#f59e0b) as the CTA color. Footer: 'DEPCON Hakodate 2024' in gray.
visual_designs.justification: CTA slides need one clear action. The QR code enables immediate participation—no URLs to remember, no complex steps. The minimal text focuses attention on the single action: scan and join.

bullet_points_minimized.justification: Out of 9 slides, zero use plain bullet points. Slide 5 uses styled cards with v-clicks (not traditional bullets). All other slides use visual strategies higher in the hierarchy: single numbers, statement layouts, diagrams, and images.

one_chart_one_message_applied.justification: Both Mermaid diagrams (slides 4 and 7) convey exactly one message each. Slide 4: 'Japan's situation vs Ethereum opportunity (contrast)'. Slide 7: 'Nyx Foundation connects you to three benefits (hub model)'. Neither diagram requires explanation beyond a single sentence.

mermaid_node_limit_respected.justification: Slide 4 uses 4 nodes, Slide 7 uses 5 nodes. Both are within the 5-node maximum. All node labels are under 20 characters. No complex nested subgraphs are used.

image_placeholders_added.justification: Added image placeholders for: Slide 1 (isolated researcher), Slide 3 (Toyama landscape for anecdote), Slide 4 (Ethereum logo), Slide 6 (Nyx Foundation logo), Slide 8 (collaboration network), Slide 9 (QR code and logo). All anecdote slides and CTA slides have appropriate visual placeholders.

color_consistency_maintained.justification: All slides follow the defined color palette: Background #0f0f0f (near-black), Primary text #ffffff (white), Secondary text #9ca3af (gray), Positive/Opportunity #22c55e (green), Negative/Problem #ef4444 (red), Brand/Highlight #8b5cf6 (purple), Accent/CTA #f59e0b (orange). Colors are used semantically: red for problems (budget cuts), green for opportunities (Ethereum, benefits), purple for brand/research, orange for CTAs.
